notes.title: Rise Eterna 2 is coming to Steam on October 9, 2025!
notes.content:
[h2]We're excited to announce that Rise Eterna 2 launches October 9 on Steam![/h2][h3]War spares none. Athracia paid a heavy price while Ars Rare is barely recovering. In the middle of an uncertain peace rises Jacht - a young Athracian soldier tasked with a mission heavy with consequences.[/h3][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]
Improving on the tactical RPG genre at the core of the first iteration, Rise Eterna 2 places you in the middle of an ongoing war between two families coveting the kingdom’s throne and one plotting its revenge.

Set within an engaging setting, play as Jacht – a devoted Athracian soldier in a mission to reclaim the Empire’s lost glory and and destroy Lua's Heroes Army.

Rise Eterna 2 includes:[/p][list][*][p]28 missions taking place across various locations and biomes combined with Strategic and Tactical combats challenging your decision-making skills[/p][/*][*][p]Terrains to use at your advantage! Depending on the type of tile units are standing on, their attacks or movement can be affected in different ways. Always try to catch the enemy at a disadvantage![/p][/*][*][p]A compelling recruitment and party organization system that lets you test various combinations and strategies at will![/p][/*][*][p]Customization with Gems: Choose from over 20 types of gems to enhance your heroes' abilities and weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Skill trees for each character with multiple factors including their own background affecting their skillset. Battle, evolve and unleash your skills in battle![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Rise Eterna 2 – A Battle for Power, Revenge, and Glory Begins!
We’re excited to present Rise Eterna 2, a thrilling sequel to the tactical RPG that takes players deeper into a world torn apart by revenge, power struggles and political schemes.

Play the demo and get an exclusive first look at the gameplay with an immersive introduction to the story that will set the stage for this exciting new chapter.

The demo includes two main missions and a tutorial that introduces you to the game’s setting and basic mechanics.

Take command of three playable characters and experience the thrill of tactical turn-based combat!
